response.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS overall_mean FROM patient_stats), patient_ratio AS (SELECT ps.ID, ps.SEX, ps.avg_pt, ps.avg_iga_igm, ps.avg_iga_igm / NULLIF(o.overall_mean, 0) AS ratio FROM patient_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall o) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_ratio GROUP BY SEX;
